admission_policy.source_policy: Owner drive-resume actual MemAvailable >= job request + fixed safety; future-growth reservations prohibited.

findings: Kernel CONSTRAINT_NONE/global_oom proves host-wide capacity exhaustion, not individual memory.max failure.
Four BF ECO containers are live while their shared job state is NEEDS_RTL; state-only own_running tracking cannot represent them.
Publication calibration remains live while its job state is NEEDS_HUMAN; cancelled qfd_res_slot has a live container. Neither can be treated as absent.
At this snapshot all surviving cgroup memory.events oom/oom_kill counters are zero; deceased PCMUX kernel record remains immutable.
Pending launch claims are calculated but not subtracted by current _fits; multiple admissions can use the same cached MemAvailable before child growth.
recommendation: Preserve all progressing containers. Hold new large AGIdock admissions until measured actual container/job inventory fits the request. An explicit short pending-launch accounting change requires owner-policy reconciliation; do not silently impose future-growth reserves or guessed per-job caps. Invalidate cached host measurement after launching and include orphan/sidecar identities in operational inventory.
